description:
PROBLEM: tests/integration/test_read_primitives_cross_surface_equivalence.py::test_read_primitives_dataframe_surface_equivalent_to_sql takes 120 s on PR CI and 233-410 s under coverage; 58% of its comparison time is the ResultValidator (45 M _cell_sort_key and 27 M _values_equal calls). Three queries return about 300 k rows.

CHANGE (product code, soundness path): in validate_results_exact (benchbox/core/tpchavoc/validation.py, consumed by benchbox/core/equivalence cross_surface.py, tpcds/qualification/runner.py and tpchavoc/benchmark.py), after the length check accept when original == variant; when order does not matter also accept when sorted(original) == sorted(variant); fall back to the existing slow path on TypeError, ValueError (comparisons of array cells raise it) or any mismatch. Never reject on the fast path.

DECISION GATES:
G1 Soundness: prove the fast path accepts only inputs the slow path accepts. Write a permanent property test (Hypothesis if the repo already uses it, else a seeded randomized test) over rows mixing int, float (including -0.0, NaN, inf, near-equal values), Decimal, None, str, bytes, dates, nested tuples and ints beyond float range (the slow path's float() overflows), ordered and unordered, asserting fast-path acceptance implies slow-path acceptance. Include the NaN-identity edge case (same NaN object on both sides) and decide it explicitly: if the slow path rejects NaN==NaN and the fast path accepts identical NaN objects, exclude rows containing floats NaN from the fast path.
G2 C2: mutate the fast path to accept a near-equal-but-not-equal float and show the property test fails.
G3 Every cross-surface gate report (ssb, coffeeshop, clickbench, joinorder-synthetic, read-primitives) and both TPC-Havoc equivalence reports have identical divergence keys and classifications before and after (compare every key), and the TPC-DS qualification tests pass unchanged.
G4 Oracle review is mandatory (soundness path); do not arm on SHIP WITH FIXES.
